Hero.Title: Domiciliation and mail: your address in Geneva, your mail taken care of
Hero.Description: We domicile you with us in Geneva, give the address to everyone who writes to you, then receive, handle and forward your mail, so there is nothing left for you to follow up.

Intro: We domicile you with us in Geneva and notify all your correspondents of your new correspondence address: banks, insurers, the tax administration and other authorities, pension and social security funds, suppliers, subscriptions. From then on the mail comes to us. We receive, sort, scan and handle it, forward it to you and follow up on what it requires, without you having to chase anyone.

When a family lives across several countries, Swiss mail becomes a sensitive point: tax assessments, letters from the authorities, invoices, statements. A letter opened too late can cost a deadline. A correspondence address remains a postal address: it does not establish your domicile or your tax residence, which depend on your actual circumstances.

Pillars.Title: Change of address with your correspondents
Pillars.Body: We notify your banks and insurers, the tax administration and other authorities, your pension and social security funds, your suppliers and your subscriptions of your correspondence address in Geneva. Following up on the change is our job, not yours.

Pillars.Title: Correspondence address
Pillars.Body: A c/o address in Geneva to receive mail for each family member, separate from your legal domicile and revocable at any time.

Pillars.Title: Receipt and scanning
Pillars.Body: Receipt, sorting and scanning of mail, then secure sharing through your digital vault; originals are kept or forwarded as you instruct.

Pillars.Title: Deadlines and replies
Pillars.Body: Spotting deadlines (tax notices, letters from the authorities, invoices) and coordinating replies with you and your advisers.

Pillars.Title: Company domiciliation
Pillars.Body: Domiciliation in Geneva of family holding or management companies. Where the rules require it, a company must have real substance and take its management decisions there; we take this into account with your advisers.

Pillars.Title: Archiving
Pillars.Body: Structured filing and archiving of the documents received, easy to retrieve for you and your advisers.

Closing.Title: Nothing goes missing
Closing.Body: Wherever you are, you know what has arrived, what needs action and what has been dealt with. We keep it all in order, discreetly.

Perimeter: A correspondence address does not create a civil domicile or a tax residence. Legal and tax questions about domicile and company substance are handled with your lawyers and tax advisers. Ridger provides mail receipt, mail management and administrative coordination. Ridger does not manage assets and does not provide investment advice.

Questions.Question: Do you notify our correspondents of our new address yourselves?
Questions.Answer: Yes. We notify your banks and insurers, the tax administration and other authorities, your pension and social security funds, your suppliers and your subscriptions. The mail then comes to us, and we sort it, handle it and forward it to you. There is nothing left for you to follow up.

Questions.Question: Do you offer company domiciliation in Geneva?
Questions.Answer: Yes, for the family's holding or management companies. Where the rules require it, a company must have real substance and take its management decisions there, and we take this into account with your advisers.

Questions.Question: Does a correspondence address in Geneva change our domicile?
Questions.Answer: No. A correspondence address remains a postal address: it creates neither a civil domicile nor a tax residence, which depend on your actual circumstances. It stays separate from your legal domicile and can be revoked at any time.

Questions.Question: How is our mail handled?
Questions.Answer: We receive, sort and scan it, then share it securely through your digital vault. Originals are kept or forwarded as you instruct.

Questions.Question: Who keeps track of deadlines in the mail?
Questions.Answer: We spot the deadlines, such as tax notices, letters from the authorities or invoices, and coordinate the replies with you and your advisers.
